title: Design System: Ledgendary marketing home (v1)
scope: site/ only (v1 alternate). Not a project-wide system; site-v2/ is a competing alternate in a different world. Derived from site/styles.css, site/index.html, site/app.js at fcc4957.

display.purpose: Hero headline; wide and heavy, max about 13.5ch.

display-wide.purpose: Closing call and feature index title; widest setting.

title.purpose: Story step headings; same wide-heavy recipe at smaller sizes for tier and playbook labels.

lede.purpose: Section and hero ledes, ink-2, 44 to 58ch.

label.purpose: Table headers, field labels, sidebar group heads; sentence case.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: A surface above a window: client sheet, derived calendar draft.

shadows.name: current-item
shadows.purpose: Active sidebar or rail item, white on mist.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus on light grounds; on the ink chapter and dark nav the outline turns gold and the halo drops.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: ease-q
motion.purpose: Declared alternate; not referenced by any rule in v1.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Standard entrance for panels and rows.

motion.name: highlighter
motion.purpose: Gold sweep under the payoff word.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Journal chain line drawing to a new entry.

motion.name: refuse
motion.purpose: A refused edit on a posted entry.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 1ms; highlighter shown full; dots and caret static

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Drops the hero sidebar; story grid tightens; playbook items stack.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Single column everywhere; nav links hidden; form stacks; story steps carry inline windows; chip and role rows scroll.

narrative.overview:
A daylight SaaS page whose proof is working product UI. White and cool mist grounds carry near-black ink; one saturated gold is the only brand colour and it behaves like a highlighter: it fills, it rarely draws. Every section is built from the same product-window anatomy (1px hairlines, 10 to 14px corners, soft layered shadows, Lucide line icons at 1.75 stroke), so the page reads as one application seen from several angles rather than a marketing collage. The same demo job and the same figures recur in every window.

Type is one variable family, Mona Sans, used at two widths: wide, heavy and tight for display, normal width for everything a person reads. Density changes by register: marketing copy is generous (17px body, 1.55 leading, 120 to 128px section padding), the product windows are app-dense (13px, 1.45 leading, 30px controls). One chapter, the books, inverts to an ink ground with dark panels; everything else stays light.

Motion is narrative rather than decorative: rows rise in, a cursor moves and presses, a highlighter sweeps under a word, a gold flash marks the money landing, a journal line draws between entries. All of it collapses under reduced motion without hiding content.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, gold, used as fill on light grounds; app semantics (green paid, blue selection, red error) live only inside product UI and form validation.
Two type registers from one family: wide display (wdth 112 to 125, weight 800) and normal-width reading text (wdth 100).
Product windows as the universal container, with labelled demo data.
Flat light sections separated by mist bands and 1px hairlines; one ink chapter.
Proportional figures by default; tabular figures only in columns.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: On light grounds gold is a fill (highlighter, button, chip, flash, dot), never a text or line colour: gold text on white is illegible. On the ink chapter gold may also colour a few marks (the chain line, fact icons, a refusal's key phrase) because there it is legible.

rules.name: The Semantics Stay Inside Rule
rules.body: Green, blue and grey tints appear only inside product windows; red appears only for form validation. Marketing copy, headings and page chrome use ink, mist and gold alone.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width plus weight (wdth 112 to 125 at 800) on display, and only display; reading text stays at wdth 100.

rules.name: The Columns Get Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures default to proportional lining (pnum, lnum). Tabular figures (tnum) apply only where numbers stand in columns: table cells, totals, journal amounts, timesheet cells. Mona Sans's tabular zero is dotted with no plain alternate, so it is kept out of prose and headline figures.

rules.name: The Windows Float, Sections Don't Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to product UI. Section bands, headings and copy never cast one.

dos: Do use gold as a fill on light grounds: one highlighter word per display heading, the primary button, the money-landed moment.
Do put every product claim inside a product window with the "Demo data" tag and the same job's figures.
Do set display at 800 weight, wdth 112 to 125, negative tracking (-0.025 to -0.04em); keep reading text at wdth 100.
Do apply tabular figures only in columns of numbers.
Do keep the focus ring as 2px ink outline with gold halo on light, gold outline on the ink chapter.
Do use soft layered ink-tinted shadows for windows and popped surfaces only.
Do make every motion beat collapse under reduced motion with its content fully visible.
donts: Don't set gold text or gold lines on white or mist.
Don't use green, blue or grey tints outside product UI, or red outside validation.
Don't put white text on gold.
Don't use hard offset shadows or shadows on section bands.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or eyebrows above headings; the build has none.
Don't use tabular figures in prose or headline figures (the dotted zero).
